events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas, leading to his death six days later.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: A moment to reflect on Tupac Shakur's enduring legacy and the impact he had on music and culture.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled talent of a guitar icon whose influence continues to resonate.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Dive into the stories behind one of music's most recognisable album covers and its timeless tracks.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 75th birthday of Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman and primary songwriter of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Rocker
angles.copy: A true rock pioneer, still delivering powerful performances and unforgettable songs.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a British rock icon, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Legend
angles.copy: The man, the myth, the legend – still making headlines and belting out anthems.

events.title: Imagine UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's iconic single "Imagine" was released in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Message
angles.copy: A powerful message of peace and unity that continues to resonate decades later.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the device that changed the game for portable music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the film franchise that began in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred, and celebrate the world's most famous spy.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour has brought joy to millions.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showcased the Fab Four at their most experimental.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost a true rock legend, Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: His voice and showmanship remain unmatched, making him one of music's greatest performers.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: An album that pushed boundaries and set the stage for a new era of pop and rock music.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this solemn day in 1980, the music world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Peace
angles.copy: His legacy as a musician, activist, and voice for peace continues to resonate globally.
